final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark HAVING COUNT(remaincount) > 0), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS benchmark FROM orderexecutions), first_filtered AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_remain FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_remain > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS benchmark FROM first_filtered), final_orders AS (SELECT f.avg_remain, b1.benchmark AS first_benchmark, b2.benchmark AS second_benchmark FROM first_filtered f CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b1 CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b2 WHERE f.avg_remain > b2.benchmark) SELECT AVG(avg_remain), AVG(avg_remain - first_benchmark), AVG(avg_remain - second_benchmark) FROM final_orders
